title: Kevin Stefanski: Tua Tagovailoa getting better, confident he'll be fully back soon

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski: Tua Tagovailoa getting better, confident he'll be fully back soon
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa was able to do some practice work on Thursday after missing the start of camp with back tightness and head coach Kevin Stefanski gave an update on how he's feeling on Friday morning.
